business_summary: Halder Venture Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells edible oil products in India and internationally. It operates through Rice and Edible Oil segments. The company offers rice products, including parboiled, white, Vietnamese, puffed, broken, and rejection rice; edible oils consisting of crude rice bran, refined rice bran, mustard, refined soyabean, refined sunflower, palmolein, and acid oils; and value-added products, such as rice bran, de-oiled rice bran, rice bran fatty acid, rice bran wax, rice husks, rice husk ashes, gums, spent earth, fatty acid, stearin, and rice lecithin. It sells its products under the Moti, Diva, Bhoj, Uma, Hira, Tumi, Bhojmoti, Odaana, and Omaana brands. The company exports its products to approximately 7 destinations across Asia and Africa. It serves the consumer, institutional, and industrial markets. Halder Venture Limited was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
